ISS-access.name: Login and account access failures
ISS-access.summary: Users repeatedly cannot log in or access their accounts, facing password rejections, false no-connection errors, forced logouts, and hacked accounts.

ISS-billing.name: Premium paywall blocks core features
ISS-billing.summary: Users report being unable to purchase or use premium subscriptions, with free users restricted from skipping or selecting songs and features like Canvas locked behind payment.

ISS-catalog.name: Missing songs and lyrics
ISS-catalog.summary: Users find songs absent from the catalog, receive only 30-second clips, or see lyrics that fail to load, along with unwanted recommendations appearing in playlists.

ISS-downloads.name: Offline downloads disappearing or failing
ISS-downloads.summary: Offline mode and downloaded content stop working, downloads get stuck or vanish, and users cannot download music without paying.

ISS-other.name: General dissatisfaction after updates
ISS-other.summary: Users express broad dissatisfaction, citing missing features and restrictions introduced in recent updates, with several saying they plan to uninstall.

ISS-playback.name: Playback failures and app crashes
ISS-playback.summary: Songs fail to play, the app crashes or freezes after updates, and playback does not work over mobile data or on certain devices.

ISS-usability.name: Confusing navigation and playback controls
ISS-usability.summary: Users struggle with navigation, such as liked songs not displaying, tapped songs playing different tracks, and restrictions on choosing songs within playlists.

severity.1: No reported problem: praise, neutral or unclear content, or a pure feature request.
severity.2: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance, or a cosmetic issue; no functional loss stated.
severity.3: A degraded or restricted function; some use or a workaround remains (e.g. too many ads, features limited, intermittent stops).
severity.4: A core task is clearly blocked, e.g. cannot log in, cannot play music, app will not open.
severity.5: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm (e.g. charged wrongly, account data exposed).
